newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GMA says output flat, mine costs down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GMA says output flat, mine costs down.

text.p: Gold Mines of Australia Ltd said on Monday December quarter production of gold and copper was in line with the previous quarter, but costs at all sites declined.
Gold production totalled 37,946 ounces versus 38,770 ounce in the September quarter, taking production in the first half of 1996/97 (July-June) to 76,999 ounces, the company said.
Output of copper concentrate, containing 5,500 tonnes of copper metal in the December quarter, took half-year production to 10,854 tonnes of metal, GMA said.
Gold cash costs averaged A$314 an ounce in the latest quarter versus A$377 an ounce in the previous quarter, it said.
Average cash costs at the Youanmi mine in Western Australia fell to A$303 an ounce in the latest quarter from A$363 an ounce in the previous quarter.
At the Reedy mine in Western Australia, gold was produced at an average cost of A$326 an ounce in the December quarter, compared with A$390 an ounce in the September quarter, the company said.
The Mount Lyell copper mine in Tasmania saw costs reduced in the December quarter to an average of US$0.90, compared with US$0.98 a pound in the previous quarter, GMA said.

At the Freddie Well Joint Venture, located near Youanmi, siginficant zinc assays were returned during the December quarter, including eight metres at 11.3 percent zinc from 43 metres, 24 metres at 10.8 percent zinc from 78 metres and 14.7 percent zinc from 12 metres, GMA said.
Lachlan Resources NL has the right to earn 60 percent equity in the Freddie Well project by spending A$2 million on the project over three years.
